subject: Pilot accelerator: request for combined credits + SKU discount (exec approval needed)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@pegasus.ai>

Cc: Asha Nair <asha@pegasus.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot scope and ask — credits + SKU discount?

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency and throughput profiles. We kicked off a short internal proof-of-value and found two important asks before we can make a recommendation to procurement:

1) An additional 50k free inference credits to run a larger, multi-day workload across our real dataset (current pilot is limited).
2) A one-time 25% discount on the first three months of committed SKU billing if we convert to a Dedicated pool within 90 days.

Both asks are bundled: the credits let us validate scale; the short-term discount makes the dedicated economics easier to model for our CFO.

Attached is a short pilot requirements doc and a one-page summary of the use case. Can Redwood accommodate this as an exec-approved exception? If yes, we can lock dates and share a quick mutual action plan.

Best,
Samir
Head of Engineering — Pegasus AI

Samir — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. I think this is reasonable but it will need a combined approval (sales + revenue ops + finance) because it includes both free credits and a temporary SKU discount.

Priyom: can you draft the proposal (credits amount, discount term, conversion trigger) and include a suggested stern guardrails list (commit term, minimum guaranteed spend, data retention assurances)? Please attach the pilot run metrics we discussed — that helps the exec review.

Ben: tagging you on the discount/verbiage and any contract caveats. If legal OKs standard terms with a short carveout, we can escalate to Marissa for the final sign-off.

Samir — I copied the internal team and we should be able to respond with an offer within 48 hours.

Thanks,

Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed accelerator package for Pegasus AI (for exec review)

Team / Samir — draft offer below for Marissa's approval. I tried to keep conditions light but protective for Redwood economics.

Offer (subject to exec approval):
- 50,000 free inference credits applied to Pegasus trial account (usable within 60 days).
- 25% off standard SKU list for the first 3 months after conversion to Dedicated (conversion defined as first paid month on Dedicated capacity).
- Minimum conversion commitment: 3 months at a $15k/month floor (to prevent churn).
- Offer expires 30 days from approval.

Conditions & guardrails:
- Credits are one-time, non-transferable, no cash value.
- Discount applies only to SKU billing for the Dedicated pool associated with the Pegasus account (not marketplace or partner resales).
- Redwood requires a short security checklist completion (SOC2 evidence + network baseline) prior to Dedicated activation.
- Legal to confirm language on termination and clawback if minimum commitment not met.

Samir — if that aligns I can send a formal term sheet and a DocuSign for signatures. Marissa, requesting your exec sign-off or any modification you want to see.

Cheers,
Priyom
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_offer_term_sheet.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Apr 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed accelerator package for Pegasus AI (for exec review)

Thanks Priyom — reviewed. High-level stance: happy to approve a one-time promotional package to accelerate conversion provided we tighten two items:

1) Increase minimum conversion commitment floor to $20k/month for 3 months (so expected revenue covers cost of credits).
2) Add a clause: if Pegasus reduces usage below 50% of committed units in months 2–3, Redwood reserves right to prorate and claw back a portion of the discount applied (standard in promo cases).

Rationale: Pegasus is strategic in our vertical and wins here could lead to platform-level references — justify the promo. But we should limit financial downside.

Ben: confirm legal language on clawback and whether the security checklist can be included as an appendix to the term sheet. If clean, I approve contingent on Ben's sign-off and Priyom updating the DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Pegasus pilot accelerator package — approved with conditions

Samir / Asha — looping back with final offer from Redwood. Apologies for the back-and-forth; appreciate your patience.

Final Offer (approved):
- 50,000 trial inference credits (one-time, valid 60 days from activation).
- 25% discount on SKU billing for the first 3 paid months post-conversion to Dedicated, contingent on a minimum conversion commitment of $20k/month for 3 months.
- Clawback clause: if usage falls below 50% of committed units in months 2–3, Redwood may prorate the discount and request repayment of a portion of credits/discount value.
- Standard security checklist (SOC2 evidence + network baseline) to be completed before Dedicated activation; included as an appendix to the term sheet.

Next steps: Priyom will send the updated term sheet via DocuSign (link below) and copy contracts@pegasus.ai. Please complete signature within 10 business days to lock commitment terms.
